command.beyondsolo.solo.help.header: System commands, all under /solo. Pick a group:
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.players: Players at the end of a command can be left out (that's you) or named: a name, @a, @p, @r.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.info: What the System knows about a player: level, rank, class, stats, mana, gold, skills, shadows, quests.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.awaken: Awakens at once with this rank and class (random when left out); the awakening trial counts as done.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.evaluate: Plays the evaluation again at the nearest crystal; a rank or class you name is the result.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.bind: Binds the System to a player who has none yet, skipping the awakening trial.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.set: Sets the level, rank, class, subclass (or none), a stat, free points, gold or exhaustion (0-100).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.add: Adds XP, levels, free points, gold or a stat (a negative number takes away).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.heal: Full health, mana, food and air; harmful effects, ailments, exhaustion and cooldowns gone.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.reset: Resets one part of the System: quests, skills, cooldowns, stats, job, shadows, gold, economy, keys, runes, tower, penalty, reeval or weaknesses.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.wipe: Starts over: system takes the System back to the very start; all makes a brand-new player (inventory, ender chest, XP and spawn point too).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.skill.learn: Teaches a skill (or every skill the player's class and subclass can hold) at a level.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.skill.forge: Forgets a skill, or all of them.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.skill.max: Every known skill to its top level.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.quest.list: The player's quests, with their progress and ids.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.quest.start: Starts a quest by its id.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.quest.compl: Completes a quest with its rewards (starting it first if needed), or every quest the player has.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.quest.fail: Fails a quest the player has taken, or all of them, with what failing costs.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.shadow.give: Puts the shadow of any creature straight into the Shadow Army.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.spawn.creat: Gate creatures in front of you: how many, their rank, variant (normal, veteran, elite, champion) and element.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.spawn.boss: A gate boss in front of you, awake (ascended if you add it).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.spawn.gate: A gate opens 5 blocks ahead: its rank, type (red, a hidden vault, shrine or lair, about to break), realm and shape.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.spawn.cache: A gate's Reward Cache of a rank in front of you.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.spawn.cryst: An Evaluation Crystal in front of you.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.village.fin: The System marks the nearest village with an Evaluation Zone for them now, as after the awakening.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.village.cle: Takes their village mark away (it comes back while they still look for a village).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.village.inf: Where their village mark is, and how far.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.gate.list: Every open gate in the world, nearest first.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.gate.close: Closes the nearest gate, or all of them (anyone inside is sent home).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.gate.break: The nearest gate breaks now and its creatures pour out.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.dungeon.ent: Into the dungeon of the nearest gate.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.dungeon.bos: To the door of the boss's room.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.dungeon.cle: Every creature of the dungeon gone and its boss slain: the way out opens.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.dungeon.lea: Out of wherever the player is held: a dungeon, a red gate, a trial, the Citadel or the Penalty Zone.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.dungeon.inf: The dungeon you are in: realm, shape, rooms, boss, element and seed.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.trial: Starts the awakening trial, the job change trial, the throne trial or the Penalty Zone now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.tower.climb: Into the Crimson Citadel, at its checkpoint or on a floor you name.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.tower.rush: Into a boss rush of a rank (or the Sovereign Rush).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.give.item: Any of the mod's items; gear rolls its bonuses like a gate drop, at a grade if you name one.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.give.armor: All four pieces of an armor set, with rolled bonuses.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.give.rune: Rune Stones holding a skill, or sealed ones of a rank.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.give.licens: A Hunter License bound to the player.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.dev: The older testing commands (/system ...), for the mod's own tests.
command.beyondsolo.solo.info.unevaluated: The System is bound but not evaluated: no rank or class yet.
command.beyondsolo.solo.info.counts: %s skills · %s shadows · %s active quests, %s done · Citadel: floor %s
command.beyondsolo.solo.reset.skills: %s's skills start over (%s given back for their level and class).
command.beyondsolo.solo.reset.stats: %s's stats are back to %s (%s points to spend again).
command.beyondsolo.solo.wipe.prompt: Wipe what? It can't be undone.
command.beyondsolo.solo.wipe.system.what: All System progress, back to the very start. Items and position stay.
command.beyondsolo.solo.wipe.all.what: A brand-new player: System, inventory, ender chest, effects, XP and spawn point, at a new random start.
command.beyondsolo.solo.wipe.all.done: %s starts over as a brand-new player.
command.beyondsolo.solo.skill.learned_al: %s knows %s skills at level %s or above.
command.beyondsolo.solo.quest.list: Quests of %s: %s in the log, %s completed, %s failed
command.beyondsolo.solo.village.marked: %s: the village with the crystal at %s is marked, %s blocks away.
command.beyondsolo.solo.village.info: %s's mark: the crystal at %s (%s), %s blocks away.
command.beyondsolo.solo.village.info.sea: %s has no village mark yet: the System is still looking.
command.beyondsolo.solo.spawn.gate.red: A rank %s gate tears open. It turns red when an awakened hunter is the first through.
command.beyondsolo.solo.spawn.gate.hidde: A rank %s gate tears open. Inside: %s.
command.beyondsolo.solo.spawn.gate.break: A rank %s gate tears open, and breaks in %s seconds.
command.beyondsolo.solo.spawn.cache: A rank %s Reward Cache is in front of you.
command.beyondsolo.solo.gate.closed: The rank %s gate at %s is closed.
command.beyondsolo.solo.dungeon.cleared_: The boss falls to %s and %s creatures are gone: the way out opens.
command.beyondsolo.solo.dungeon.clearing: %s is taken to the boss (%s creatures gone); it falls once its room has loaded.
command.beyondsolo.solo.trial.penalty: %s is sent to the Penalty Zone.
command.beyondsolo.solo.tower.climb: %s climbs the Crimson Citadel from floor %s.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.not_evalua: %s hasn't been evaluated yet (no rank or class).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.not_on_the: %s isn't looking for a village (that needs the System and no evaluation yet).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_zone_fo: No village with an Evaluation Zone was found anywhere near %s.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.unknown_pa: There is no part %s to reset.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.quest_cann: Quest %s can't start for this player (wrong rank, class or place?).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.gate_here: Gates don't open inside a dungeon.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.unknown_ga: There is no gate type %s (normal, red, vault, shrine, lair, breaking).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_red_wor: The red gates' world isn't loaded on this server.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.breaks_off: Dungeon breaks are turned off in the config.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.red_sealed: The red gate is sealed: no one else gets in.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.not_held: %s isn't in a dungeon, red gate, trial, Citadel or Penalty Zone.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.trial_not_: The awakening trial can't start here.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.busy: %s is busy with something else (a trial, a run or the Penalty Zone).
